overview_description.description: LoadMe is a UAE-based logistics and freight technology platform connecting shippers with transport providers through digital load-matching solutions. The platform streamlines cargo booking, fleet utilization, shipment tracking, and transportation management for businesses and truck operators. LoadMe aims to improve logistics efficiency, reduce empty truck trips, and enable smarter, technology-driven freight operations across regional supply chains.
